core_obligations: Construct the graded cable-algebra action from full-twist cobordism maps; same degrees and tower injectivity determine equal maps.
Produce every torus-link tower generator as a balanced monomial and prove relations are complete, retaining the author non-adjacent-to-adjacent relation reduction in thm:Tnm.

proof_roadmap.step: Compute h on diagonal and adjacent gradings, then construct bounded coordinate tuple I-prime and use U_iV_i trading to reduce all remote relations.
Match degree-homogeneous algebra relations with injective cobordism maps on rank-one Floer towers.
Balanced monomial generators give surjectivity; quadratic extremal-index reduction and Tnm complete relations give injectivity.
